items.raw_excerpt: Thousands of elderly people are caring for loved ones well into their own 80s and 90s—with many unaware of the support available to them.
items.summary_en: Thousands of elderly people in Finland care for loved ones into their 80s and 90s. Many do not know about the support available to them.
items.summary_ko: 수천 명의 핀란드 고령자들이 80대, 90대 나이에도 가족을 돌보고 있다. 많은 이들이 정부 지원을 받을 수 있다는 사실조차 모르고 있다.
items.title_en: Finland's ageing caregivers: I never thought of not caring for him
items.title_original: Finland's ageing caregivers: "I never thought of not caring for him"

items.raw_excerpt: The ban on the use of smartphones in schools is to be extended to pupils in 7th and 9th grade as early as the next academic year, according to an amendment to the Pupils’ Statute due to be approved by the Council of Ministers.
items.summary_en: Portugal plans to ban smartphones for 7th and 9th grade students starting next school year. The rule will be added to the Pupils' Statute and approved by the Council of Ministers.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈이 다음 학기부터 7학년과 9학년 학생까지 학교에서 스마트폰을 사용하지 못하도록 금지할 예정이다. 이 규정은 각의 승인을 거쳐 학생 규정에 추가된다.
items.title_en: Portugal extends smartphone ban in schools to 9th grade
items.title_ko: 포르투갈, 학교 내 스마트폰 사용 금지를 9학년까지 확대
items.title_original: Portugal extends ban on smartphones in schools to 9th grade

items.raw_excerpt: An unfinished Sheraton resort project has been terminated after sitting abandoned for years in Vietnam's largest island Phu Quoc.
items.summary_en: An unfinished Sheraton resort project on Phu Quoc island has been terminated. The building sat abandoned for years and will now be demolished.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 최대 섬 푸꾸옥에 방치된 쉐라톤 리조트 건설 프로젝트가 철거된다. 완공되지 못한 채 수년간 버려져 있던 이 리조트가 결국 철거 확정됐다.
items.title_en: Abandoned Sheraton Resort in Phu Quoc to be Torn Down
items.title_original: Abandoned Sheraton resort project in Vietnam's largest island Phu Quoc to be demolished

items.raw_excerpt: Feeling slow and sluggish in these hot late summer days? You're not alone – and we have the perfect German word for you.
items.summary_en: The German word 'Hundstage' describes the hot and sluggish late summer days. Many people feel slow and tired during this time. This word captures the lazy summer feeling perfectly.
items.summary_ko: 독일어 '훈트스타게'는 늦여름의 무더운 날들을 가리키는 단어입니다. 많은 사람들이 이 시기에 느릿해지고 피곤함을 느낍니다. 이 단어는 나른한 여름날의 기분을 완벽하게 표현해줍니다.
items.title_en: German word of the day: Hundstage
items.title_original: German word of the day: Hundstage

items.raw_excerpt: Dramatic fall in puffin numbers on Lofoten island, Rental market in Norway red hot as students seek flats, and other news from Norway on Thursday.
items.summary_en: Puffin numbers have fallen dramatically on an island in the Lofoten archipelago. Scientists are concerned about the decline of this iconic seabird.

items.title_en: Puffin numbers drop sharply on Lofoten island

items.raw_excerpt: Starting this fall, Alberta employers will have to cover the cost of health insurance for employees over the age of 65.
items.summary_en: Starting this fall, Alberta employers will have to pay for health insurance for employees over 65. The new rule changes who pays for health benefits for older workers.
items.summary_ko: 올가을부터 앨버타주 고용주는 65세 이상 직원의 건강보험 비용을 부담해야 합니다. 새로운 규정이 고령 근로자의 건강 혜택 비용 부담 주체를 변경합니다.
items.title_en: Alberta employers must pay health insurance for workers over 65

items.title_original: Working past 65 in Alberta? Your health benefits could soon cost your employer more
